summary: JIT grill of merge-survivable-hooks (the crash-loop fix) against spec, decision 0045/0046, and lesson hooks-must-fail-closed-with-recovery. Fallback allow-list, merge detection, and auto-heal trigger resolved; contract kept.
current_flow: pre_tool_use and stop_continue import factory_lib/forge_cli at module top and load run.json at module level, so a conflict-markered factory_lib (SyntaxError at import) or run.json (JSONDecodeError at load) crashes EVERY hook; stop_continue's crash exits non-zero and re-invokes the model in an unrecoverable loop, and the crashed pre_tool_use denies the very git commands that would resolve the merge. Task 5 wraps imports/loads with a self-contained static deny-list fallback and adds a mid-merge git-resolution carve-out plus forge-next auto-heal.

criteria_map.the carve-out matrix passes: resolution: test_hook_permits_git_native_resolution_on_unmerged_paths + test_hook_refuses_handwrite_and_merged_paths_during_merge assert the per-path matrix (git ls-files -u set allowed, merged paths + content hand-writes refused); test_hook_denylist_fallback_on_unparseable_state_or_import asserts a broken factory_lib/run.json engages the self-contained deny-list (product write denied, git-recovery + read allowed) without crashing
criteria_map.forge next heals the roadmap after a mer: test_forge_next_auto_heals_roadmap_after_merge seeds a roadmap.json with duplicate keys (a merge union) and asserts forge next runs heal (done-wins) once, idempotently

new_abstractions: A self-contained static deny-list block in pre_tool_use/stop_continue that runs WITHOUT factory_lib (inline stdin parse + hardcoded product-prefix deny + git-recovery/read allow). Reversible: only engages when the normal import/load fails; the parseable path is unchanged.

resolutions: Git-recovery verbs + all read-only (operator 2026-08-18): the fallback ALLOWS git checkout --ours/--theirs, git rm/add/reset, git merge/rebase/cherry-pick --abort, and read-only tools; DENIES every Edit/Write and other Bash write. Hardcoded, no factory_lib dependency. Not 'deny everything' (that reproduces the trap) and not hand-writing .factory state (violates evidence-only-via-recorders).

git ls-files -u for the path set, MERGE_HEAD/rebase-apply|rebase-merge presence as the mid-merge gate (operator 2026-08-18): git-native resolution passes only for the exact unmerged paths; merged paths and content hand-writes refused - the full per-path matrix.

Heal when roadmap.json has duplicate keys (operator 2026-08-18): forge next runs heal only when duplicates exist (the exact merge-union condition); heal_items is a no-op otherwise, so it's self-limiting and idempotent - no merge-commit marker plumbing.

Fold the test fix into task 5 (test_gates.py in scope, promoted to required test): change the pattern tuple `.factory/*.jsonl` -> `.factory/signals.jsonl`. Do NOT re-add the wildcard to .gitattributes. Task-3 followup, not a hook change.
